title: DIGIT HR

frontend.summary: Frappe-hosted single-page app served at /digit-hr by www/digit-hr.html, reading and writing native HRMS/ERPNext records through digit_hr.api.bridge (permission-scoped reads, allowlisted transactional writes).
frontend.gap: The compiled SPA bundle is not in this repository and cannot be built here: the HR snapshot's hosted entry (src/host/frappe, vite.frappe.config.ts, scripts/frappe/build-spa.ts) needs a Frappe host bridge in the shared Core (src/lib/host.ts plus adapter read/write hooks) that the approved Final Core does not have. Porting it changes protected Core files and needs owner approval (HR-B7).

integrations.name: GeoInTime attendance
integrations.needs: Optional. No signed technical specification or credentials were provided; no connector is shipped.

integrations.name: Qiwa / GOSI / Mudad
integrations.needs: Not included. Requires signed technical specifications and explicit permission before any connector is built.

env.name: digit_hr_allow_demo (site config)
env.purpose: Disposable test sites only: allows `bench execute digit_hr.demo.load`. Never set on staging/production data.

staging_checks: After install, open /digit-hr as HR Manager, HR User and Employee; each sees only permitted companies, employees and salary data.
Open each of the seven modules and a section workspace; KPI counts match the native lists they drill into.
Create and submit a Leave Application from DIGIT HR; it appears in the native HRMS list with the same status.
Switch the user language to Arabic: the app renders RTL with Arabic labels.
bench --site <staging-site> execute digit_hr.api.health.check reports no blocking issue.
bench --site <staging-site> uninstall-app digit_hr removes DIGIT DocTypes only; native HRMS/ERPNext records stay.
known_limitations: The compiled /digit-hr frontend bundle is absent (see frontend gap, HR-B7); without it the /digit-hr page cannot load on Frappe. Desk DocTypes, reports, workflow, sidebar and dock entries still install.
Integration blockers HR-B1..B6 from the Final Core import remain open (docs/digit-app-builder/HR_INTEGRATION_BLOCKERS.md).
The package README reports an install on a disposable Frappe 16.52 sandbox from the HR snapshot; that evidence is not part of this repository and was not re-run for this build.
pyproject requires Python >=3.14,<3.15 while the package README table says >=3.10; the release follows pyproject.
The virtual plugin manifest (0.1.0) and the Frappe package (1.0.0) are independent version lines.
